name: Diablo Grande
also: refered by many newspaper articles as the  "Oak Flats Valley Ranch" or the "Oak Flats Valley"

climate: Summers are close to rainless. Vines draw on water stored in the soil, or on irrigation, but disease is rare.

blurb.text: A California AVA in the western foothills of Stanislaus County, all on private land within a gated resort community. Its 30,000 acres have vineyards at 1,000 to 1,800 feet.
